Name: Ishbi-benob
Summary: Ishbi-benob, a descendant of the giant and armed with a new sword and a spear weighing three hundred shekels of brass, thought to slay David when he grew faint in battle. Abishai rescued David and killed him.
KeyStory: Ishbi-benob nearly killed an exhausted David — and Abishai cut him down.
LifeLesson: Even giants fall to the friends who refuse to let a king fight alone.
